en.title: Model application threats
en.description: Map assets, trust boundaries, abuse paths, and mitigations using repository evidence.
tasks: Map assets, trust boundaries, abuse paths, and mitigations using repository evidence.
prerequisites: An authorized source repository plus deployment and authentication context.
en.example: Use security-threat-model. Threat-model this file-upload service, identifying trust boundaries and the highest-impact abuse paths.
en.expectedResult: A repository-grounded Markdown threat model with explicit assumptions.
limitations: The result depends on supplied architecture and deployment information.

zh.title: 应用威胁建模
zh.description: 依据仓库证据梳理资产、信任边界、滥用途径与缓解措施。
tasks: 依据仓库证据梳理资产、信任边界、滥用途径与缓解措施。
prerequisites: 获授权源代码仓库，以及部署和鉴权背景。
zh.example: 请使用 security-threat-model：为此文件上传服务建立威胁模型，识别信任边界与高影响滥用途径。
zh.expectedResult: 基于仓库、明确列出假设的 Markdown 威胁模型。
limitations: 结果受所提供架构与部署信息完整性影响。
